findings.interpretation: Metadata materialization and state hashing dominate. Snapshot clones are measurable but smaller. Workspace retains all 999,999 document records; measured RSS includes mappings, caches and allocator retention, not exact live-heap ownership.

integrity: Source/graph hashes match across both isolated stores and the original fixture, prepared graph archives and binaries are unchanged, all 408 candidate source hashes verify, and pre-existing staged work is unchanged. Diagnostics-off probes repeat candidate source/graph and graph-archive integrity checks.
